name: presentation-agent-starter-reference-catalog
purpose: Provide a broad, provenance-rich starter catalog of presentation design, PPT/HTML, asset, theory, research, and conversion sources for presentation-agent.

reader_guide.summary: This catalog is a source discovery map for presentation-agent. It stores metadata, quality signals, license status, and conversion routing before any raw file is stored.
how_to_read: Start with structure_rules to understand the metadata-first and license-gated policy.
Use field_guide to interpret each record field.
Filter records by source_type when planning a research lane.
Filter by html_conversion before deciding whether to build HTML natively, extract PPTX text, or manually rebuild a reference.
Re-check the original source terms before downloading or converting any raw file.
update_triggers: A new high-quality presentation source is found.
A source license, terms page, or access model changes.
A record is promoted from metadata-only to raw storage allowed.
A conversion candidate is validated or rejected.
reader_guide.copyright_position: Most sources are metadata-only references. Raw storage is allowed only when download_allowed=true and the source terms still support the intended use.

structure_rules.rule: Each record must preserve source URL, access date, source type, license status, and HTML conversion path.
structure_rules.reason: Future agents need source provenance and conversion routing without relying on chat memory.

structure_rules.rule: Use official docs, official galleries, or primary repositories when available.
structure_rules.reason: Primary sources reduce hallucination and licensing mistakes.

structure_rules.rule: Community popularity is a quality signal only; it is not proof of factual correctness or reuse permission.
structure_rules.reason: Likes, views, and comments can help discovery but do not establish truth or legal use.

structure_rules.rule: For unknown, paid, or account-gated sources, store metadata only.
structure_rules.reason: The project must not mirror copyrighted or restricted presentation files.

structure_rules.rule: For PPT/PPTX sources, prefer HTML reconstruction or text-structure extraction until a high-fidelity conversion path is verified.
structure_rules.reason: PPTX visual fidelity and licensing require separate checks before conversion output is trusted.

field_guide.meaning: Stable kebab-case identifier for cross-linking conversion notes and generated artifacts.
Source role such as html_framework, template_gallery, design_gallery, asset_library, presentation_theory, ai_presentation_research, or conversion_tool_reference.
Main formats the source can inform: html, markdown, pptx, google_slides, figma, images, icons, fonts, animations, pdf, or article.
Conservative reuse status based on current source type and visible source context.
Whether raw files may be stored locally without another per-item license check.
native_html, pptx_requires_conversion, manual_rebuild_recommended, reference_only, or asset_reference.
Evidence that the source is worth checking, such as official, open_source, curated, popular, broad_catalog, designer_signal, practitioner_signal, or research_signal.
